name: Opposite-Triple Nonperipheral Class
definition: On each of two disjoint three-coordinate blocks let $A_0=B_0=\{000\}$, $A_1=B_1=\{000,100,101,111\}$, and $A_2=B_2=\{0,1\}^3\setminus\{001\}$. Add path coordinates $(a,b)$ and take fibers $A_0\times B_2$ at $00$, $A_1\times B_1$ at $10$, and $A_2\times B_0$ at $11$.
properties: The class has 30 words on eight coordinates, is ample of VC dimension two, and has an explicit rank-two maximum parent with 46 words on nine coordinates. It is dismantlable because every two-dimensional ample class is dismantlable. No coordinate has nested shores, so it is not recursively peripheral.
